newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian states 16.09 bln rupee loans oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Indian states 16.09 bln rupee loans oversubscribed.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Tuesday it raised 28.0 billion rupees against a target of 16.09 billion rupees in a loan issue by Indian states earlier this week.
The states would not retain the oversubscribed amount, an RBI spokeswoman told Reuters.
Full allotments were made for some states while others received partial allotment, RBI said in a statement.
The loans have a 10 year tenure and carry a coupon rate of 13.75 percent. The loans opened for subscription on January 20.
